mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate for equity valuation and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the rate remains below 3.0%.
failure_condition: Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when UNRATE > 4.0% over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity weakens.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC of the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 112.0) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during expansionary cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO > 112.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) strengthens consumer spending power and corporate profit growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as labor market conditions improve.
failure_condition: Rank IC of PAYEMS with 20-day SPX returns is less than 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1150.0 thousand units signals weakening residential construction, reducing economic activity and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when HOUST < 1150.0 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 255.0) and elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 2.5%) signal aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as equity valuations contract.
failure_condition: The interaction of CPIAUCSL > 255.0 and FEDFUNDS > 2.5% fails to produce negative 20-day returns in >60% of cases, or Rank IC of the interaction term is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 18700.0 billion dollars) indicates robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle phases.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when GDPC1 > 18700.0 over any 3-year rolling window.
